shared_tail.surface: عباد بن عبد الله بن الزبير

notes: the second isnad begins «وحدثني» with no «ح»; the text writes «قال أخبرني ابن أبي مليكة» once after both branches meet at «ابن جريج», so the tail applies to both (rule 3)
the two «ابن جريج» are separate written links in their branches; not merged (rule 9)
